response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_got) AS overall FROM p) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.overall AS diff FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_got - o.overall) IS NULL, p.avg_got - o.overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall figure is the mean of the per-patient average GOT values. Patients whose GOT is all NULL are excluded from that mean, and their difference is NULL.
Ties in the difference are broken arbitrarily, because the request gives no tie-breaker.
